name: Second Chance Welding
old_description: We Provide Professional Solutions To Deliver Safe & Efficient Projects
about:
Second Chance Welding operates from a shop at 697 Killingly Street in Johnston, Rhode Island. The business is owned by Andrew Quinn, who holds certifications across a range of material thicknesses. The company focuses on giving vehicles and equipment a second chance through certified automotive rust repair, fabrication, and structural steel welding.

The shop provides rust repair, welding, and fabrication services, including structural steel welding and mobile welding at customer sites. Work is performed at a shop rate of $100 per hour plus materials, with a mobile rate of $125 per hour plus materials. Minimum charges apply: $100 for shop jobs under one hour and $500 for mobile jobs under four hours. All estimates are free and offered Monday through Friday from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m., with no estimates on Wednesdays or Saturdays unless by appointment.

Customers include automotive owners and operators of heavy equipment needing rust repair or custom fabrication. The shop accepts money orders, certified bank checks, and major credit cards with a 4% processing fee; personal checks are not accepted. Completed vehicles or parts must be retrieved within 48 hours to avoid a $25-per-day storage fee.

The company’s stated mission is to deliver professional solutions that ensure safe and efficient projects, emphasizing the owner’s certification in every material thickness as a key differentiator.
